title: GMEOW claim emission
description: The flat shape a model emits per extracted claim (one JSON object per JSONL line) — #298's structured-output contract, mirrored by `gmeow audit --json`. No RDF is required of the model (CONSTITUTION P13); the harness converts valid emissions onto the claim spine and runs the #55 audit gates over them.

text.description: The claim, as one self-contained sentence.

confidence.description: Calibrated credence — scored against measured grounding.

source.description: The source document id this claim was extracted from (a corpus sourceLocation). Required: multi-document runs are scored per source.

evidence.description: Pinned spans. A claim with no supporting span is scored as a hallucination.

quote.description: The EXACT passage, verbatim from the source (the re-anchorable selector).

start.description: Unicode code-point offset, zero-based inclusive (binds to the source digest).

end.description: Offset, exclusive. MUST exceed start (cross-field constraints are beyond declarative JSON Schema; the harness span verifier enforces it at runtime).
